When a `Map` of previously seen slugs is passed, repeated slugs get `-1`, `-2`, … suffixes. `toc` and `headingIds` use one map per document. ## Output conventions Follow CommonMark 0.31 HTML output (as produced by the reference implementation commonmark.js) plus GFM tables and strikethrough, except where this spec says otherwise.
